name: claude-kit
description: Project-agnostic Claude Code plugins: architecture rubrics, a plan-review-implement pipeline with agent evals, and QA skills.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Clean Architecture, SOLID and DDD rubrics for PHP (Symfony, Magento 2) and JavaScript/TypeScript, with an implementer's cut and stack references.

plugins.name: pipeline
plugins.description: Plan, review and implement features: the feature and bug-fix commands, the devils-advocate reviewer, the feature-contract-writer and feature-implementer agents, and an eval harness that regression-tests those agents.

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: Quality skills: bug-hunt walks a live site in a real browser and proves what breaks; tighten shortens text without losing meaning.
